section.content: The invention discloses a water-based binder, a preparation method of the water-based binder and a lithium ion battery, and belongs to the technical field of lithium ion batteries, wherein the water-based binder is calculated according to the mass ratio: the polymer is prepared by polymerizing 5-10 anionic surfactant, 7-14 parts of methyl propyl methyl acrylate monomer, 4-8 parts of crosslinking monomer, 4-8 parts of acrylonitrile monomer, 01-0.3 part of initiator and 70-80 parts of deionized water; the aqueous binder can generate high cohesiveness to inorganic powder and a base film, can improve the water resistance of an inorganic coating, lays a good foundation for the second-layer aqueous coating of the composite diaphragm, and solves the problems of low peeling degree, powder falling and the like of the second-layer aqueous coating of the diaphragm.

本发明公开了一种水性粘结剂、水性粘结剂的制备方法及锂离子电池，属于锂离子电池技术领域，所述水性粘结剂按照质量比计算：以5‑10阴离子表面活性剂、7‑14份甲基丙基酸甲酯单体、4‑8份交联单体、4‑8份丙烯腈单体、01‑0.3份引发剂和70‑80份去离子水聚合而成；本发明中水性粘结剂不仅能对无机粉体和基膜产生高粘结性，还能提高无机涂层耐水性能，为复合隔膜第二层水性涂覆打下良好基础，解决隔膜第二层水性涂覆剥离度降低，掉粉等问题。

Water-based binder, preparation method of water-based binder and lithium ion batteryTechnical Field

The invention relates to an aqueous binder, a preparation method of the aqueous binder and a lithium ion battery, and belongs to the technical field of lithium ion batteries.

Background

In a lithium ion battery, a diaphragm is one of four main materials, and the main function of the diaphragm is to realize transportation and conduction of lithium ions in the battery; meanwhile, electron conduction is avoided, and further short circuit caused by short circuit of the anode and the cathode of the battery is prevented. The performance of the diaphragm not only determines the interface structure, internal resistance, capacity, circulation and other electrical properties of the battery, but also plays a vital role in the safety performance of the battery. The type of battery is different, and the separator used is also different.

In order to improve the performance of the membrane, a ceramic coating membrane is one of the common technical means in the field, wherein the ceramic coating membrane is a novel high-safety membrane material which is formed by coating a layer of nanoscale aluminum oxide material or other nonmetallic materials on the surface of a traditional polyolefin microporous membrane and then tightly bonding the coating and a base membrane through special process treatment. The ceramic coating has good temperature resistance and electrolyte affinity, so that the heat shrinkage performance and the liquid retention performance of the diaphragm under the high temperature condition can be obviously improved. Meanwhile, in order to enable the ceramic diaphragm to be tightly attached to the lithium ion battery pole piece and improve the performances of battery core circulation and the like, collagen coating such as PVDF and the like is widely applied. In order to ensure the temperature resistance and the adhesion performance of the composite diaphragm and the pole piece, the base film needs to be coated with secondary water: coating the first layer respectively: inorganic ceramic, second layer: and (3) coating organic collagen. However, as the first layer of coating is an aqueous coating, the aqueous slurry can cause the binder in the first layer of ceramic coating to fail or weaken during the second layer of collagen coating, so that the peeling strength of the composite diaphragm is reduced, and even the problems of powder falling, falling and the like of the coating are caused.

Disclosure of Invention

The invention aims to overcome the defects in the prior art, and provides an aqueous binder, a preparation method of the aqueous binder and a lithium ion battery, wherein the aqueous binder is prepared by adopting the technical means of micelle polymerization and copolymerization of methyl methacrylate monomer, slightly soluble aqueous monomer and crosslinking monomer, and is used for preparing the ceramic coating diaphragm prepared from aqueous slurry, and the adhesive performance in the ceramic coating is not invalid or reduced when the ceramic coating is prepared from the binder for secondary aqueous coating, so that the problems of coating falling or reduced peeling strength and the like of the ceramic coating caused by secondary aqueous coating are avoided.

In order to achieve the above purpose, the invention is realized by adopting the following technical scheme:

In a first aspect, the present invention provides an aqueous binder, the aqueous binder comprising: 5-10 parts of anionic surfactant, 7-14 parts of methyl propyl acrylate monomer, 4-8 parts of crosslinking monomer, 4-8 parts of acrylonitrile monomer, 0.1-0.3 part of initiator and 70-80 parts of deionized water.

Further, the anionic surfactant comprises at least one of sodium dodecyl sulfate, sodium dodecyl carboxylate, sodium dodecyl benzene sulfonate and sodium oleoyl methyl taurate.

Further, the crosslinking monomer is at least one of tetraethoxysilane, styrene, aziridine, diimine, divinylbenzene and diacetone acrylamide.

Further, the initiator comprises at least one of ammonium persulfate, potassium persulfate, azo diisobutyl amidine hydrochloride and sodium bisulphite.

In a second aspect, the present invention provides a method for preparing an aqueous binder, comprising:

preparing each raw material according to the raw material types and proportions of the aqueous binder;

Adding the anionic surfactant and deionized water in the raw materials into a reaction vessel, and stirring and mixing;

Methyl propyl acid methyl ester monomer, crosslinking monomer and acrylonitrile monomer in the raw materials are added into the reaction vessel and stirred to obtain mixed solution;

Reducing the stirring rotation speed, heating the mixed solution, dropwise adding the aqueous solution and the initiator in the raw materials into the reaction container, and stopping stirring after the dropwise adding is finished;

And (3) after the heat preservation is continued for a set time, obtaining a sample, taking out and crushing the sample, and baking the sample for a set time at a set temperature to obtain the water-based adhesive.

Further, when the anionic surfactant and deionized water in the raw materials are added into a reaction vessel and stirred and mixed, the raw materials are stirred for 1 to 10 hours at a rotating speed of 1000 to 1500 r/min.

Further, when methyl propyl acid methyl ester monomer, crosslinking monomer and acrylonitrile monomer in the raw materials are added into the reaction vessel and stirred, the mixture is stirred for 10 to 60 minutes at a rotating speed of 1000 to 1500r/min to obtain a mixed solution.

Further, after the mixed solution is obtained, the stirring speed is reduced to 50-200r/min, and the mixed solution is heated to 40-70 ℃.

Further, dropwise adding an aqueous solution, and an initiator in the raw materials into the reaction container for 1-30min, wherein the continuous heat preservation setting time is 5-10h, and the concentration of the initiator is 5-20wt%.

In a third aspect, the present invention provides a lithium ion battery comprising a separator comprising a ceramic coating comprising a binder therein, the binder being an aqueous binder as described in any one of the preceding claims.

Compared with the prior art, the invention has the beneficial effects that:

1. the aqueous binder of the invention not only can generate high cohesiveness to inorganic powder and a base film, but also can improve the water resistance of an inorganic coating, lays a good foundation for the aqueous coating of the second layer of the composite diaphragm, and solves the problems of reduced peeling degree, powder falling and the like of the aqueous coating of the second layer of the diaphragm.

2. The aqueous binder prepared by the invention is used for coating the diaphragm of the lithium ion battery ceramic, the peeling of the diaphragm coating is hardly reduced before and after soaking, the peeling strength is more than 140N/m, and the diaphragm prepared by coating the aqueous slurry for the second time has the advantages of no reduction in peeling strength, no powder falling and the like.

Drawings

Fig. 1 is a flowchart of a preparation method of an aqueous binder according to an embodiment of the present invention.

Detailed Description

The invention is further described below with reference to the accompanying drawings. The following examples are only for more clearly illustrating the technical aspects of the present invention, and are not intended to limit the scope of the present invention.

The invention relates to an aqueous binder comprising: the raw materials of the aqueous binder comprise: 5-10 parts of anionic surfactant, 7-14 parts of methyl methylpropionate monomer, 4-8 parts of crosslinking monomer, 4-8 parts of acrylonitrile monomer, 0.1-0.3 part of initiator and 70-80 parts of deionized water;

Wherein the anionic surfactant comprises at least one of sodium dodecyl sulfate, sodium dodecyl carboxylate, sodium dodecyl benzene sulfonate and sodium oleoyl methyl taurate;

the crosslinking monomer is at least one of tetraethoxysilane, styrene, aziridine, diimine, divinylbenzene and diacetone acrylamide;

the initiator comprises at least one of ammonium persulfate, potassium persulfate, azo diisobutyl amidine hydrochloride and sodium bisulfite.

As shown in fig. 1, the present invention describes a method for preparing the above aqueous binder, comprising:

preparing each raw material according to the raw material types and proportions of the aqueous binder;

Adding the anionic surfactant and deionized water in the raw materials into a reaction vessel, and stirring for 1-10h at a rotating speed of 1000-1500 r/min;

Methyl propyl acid methyl ester monomer, crosslinking monomer and acrylonitrile monomer in the raw materials are added into the reaction vessel and stirred for 10-60min at the rotating speed of 1000-1500r/min to obtain mixed solution;

Reducing the stirring rotation speed to 50-200r/min, heating the mixed solution to 40-70 ℃, dropwise adding an aqueous solution and an initiator in the raw materials into the reaction container, wherein the concentration of the initiator is 5-20wt%, the dropwise adding time is 1-30min, and stopping stirring after the dropwise adding is completed;

And (3) keeping the temperature for 5-10 hours to obtain a sample, taking out the sample, crushing the sample, and baking the sample for a set time at a set temperature to obtain the water-based adhesive.

In addition, the invention also discloses a lithium ion battery, which comprises a diaphragm, wherein the diaphragm comprises a ceramic coating, the ceramic coating comprises a binder, and the binder is the aqueous binder.

The following examples are provided to further illustrate embodiments of the invention. The embodiments of the present invention are not limited to the following specific embodiments. The modification can be appropriately performed within the scope of the main claim.

Example 1

This example describes an aqueous binder, which is prepared as follows:

7g of sodium dodecyl carboxylate and 70g of deionized water were added to the reaction vessel and stirred at 1200r/min for 5 hours.

7G of methyl methacrylate monomer, 4g of cyclohexylimine monomer and 4g of acrylonitrile monomer are sequentially added into a reaction vessel, stirring is carried out for 30 minutes at a rotating speed of 1200r/min to obtain a mixed solution, the stirring speed is reduced to 120r/min, the mixed solution is heated to 60 ℃, 15wt% of aqueous solution and 0.2g of ammonium persulfate are dropwise added into the reaction vessel for 20 minutes, stirring is stopped after the dropwise addition is completed, and a sample is taken out after continuous heat preservation for 8 hours. After crushing the sample to 100 mesh, baking at 85 ℃ for 10 hours to obtain the aqueous binder.

The embodiment also discloses a lithium ion battery, which comprises a diaphragm, wherein the diaphragm comprises a ceramic coating, the ceramic coating comprises a binder, and the binder is the aqueous binder.

Example 2

This example describes an aqueous binder, which is prepared as follows:

5g of sodium dodecyl carboxylate and 70g of deionized water were added to the reaction vessel and stirred at 1200r/min for 5 hours.

Adding 7g of methyl methacrylate monomer, 4g of cyclohexylimine monomer and 4g of acrylonitrile monomer into a reaction vessel in sequence, stirring at a rotating speed of 1200r/min for 30 minutes to obtain a mixed solution, reducing the stirring speed to 120r/min, heating the mixed solution to 60 ℃, dropwise adding 0.2g of ammonium persulfate which is 15wt% of aqueous solution into the reaction vessel for 20 minutes, stopping stirring after the dropwise adding is finished, continuously preserving heat for 8 hours, and taking out a sample. After crushing the sample to 100 mesh, baking at 85 ℃ for 10 hours to obtain the aqueous binder.

The embodiment also discloses a lithium ion battery, which comprises a diaphragm, wherein the diaphragm comprises a ceramic coating, the ceramic coating comprises a binder, and the binder is the aqueous binder.

Example 3

This example describes an aqueous binder, which is prepared as follows:

7g of sodium dodecyl carboxylate and 70g of deionized water were added to the reaction vessel and stirred at 1200r/min for 5 hours.

Adding 7g of methyl methacrylate monomer, 4g of cyclohexylimine monomer and 8g of acrylonitrile monomer into a reaction vessel in sequence, stirring at a rotating speed of 1200r/min for 30 minutes to obtain a mixed solution, reducing the stirring speed to 120r/min, heating the mixed solution to 60 ℃, dropwise adding 0.2g of ammonium persulfate which is 15wt% of aqueous solution into the reaction vessel for 20 minutes, stopping stirring after the dropwise adding is finished, continuously preserving heat for 8 hours, and taking out a sample. After crushing the sample to 100 mesh, baking at 85 ℃ for 10 hours to obtain the aqueous binder.

The embodiment also discloses a lithium ion battery, which comprises a diaphragm, wherein the diaphragm comprises a ceramic coating, the ceramic coating comprises a binder, and the binder is the aqueous binder.

Example 4

This example describes an aqueous binder, which is prepared as follows:

7g of sodium dodecyl carboxylate and 70g of deionized water were added to the reaction vessel and stirred at 1200r/min for 5 hours.

14G of methyl methacrylate monomer, 4g of cyclohexylimine monomer and 4g of acrylonitrile monomer are sequentially added into a reaction vessel, stirring is carried out for 30 minutes at a rotating speed of 1200r/min to obtain a mixed solution, the stirring speed is reduced to 120r/min, the mixed solution is heated to 60 ℃, 0.2g of ammonium persulfate which is 15wt% of aqueous solution is dropwise added into the reaction vessel for 20 minutes, stirring is stopped after the dropwise addition is completed, and a sample is taken out after continuous heat preservation for 8 hours. After crushing the sample to 100 mesh, baking at 85 ℃ for 10 hours to obtain the aqueous binder.

The embodiment also discloses a lithium ion battery, which comprises a diaphragm, wherein the diaphragm comprises a ceramic coating, the ceramic coating comprises a binder, and the binder is the aqueous binder.

Example 5

This example describes an aqueous binder, which is prepared as follows:

7g of sodium dodecyl carboxylate and 70g of deionized water were added to the reaction vessel and stirred at 1200r/min for 5 hours.

Adding 7g of methyl methacrylate monomer, 8g of cyclohexylimine monomer and 4g of acrylonitrile monomer into a reaction vessel in sequence, stirring at a rotating speed of 1200r/min for 30 minutes to obtain a mixed solution, reducing the stirring speed to 120r/min, heating the mixed solution to 60 ℃, dropwise adding 0.2g of ammonium persulfate which is 15wt% of aqueous solution into the reaction vessel for 20 minutes, stopping stirring after the dropwise adding is finished, continuously preserving heat for 8 hours, and taking out a sample. After crushing the sample to 100 mesh, baking at 85 ℃ for 10 hours to obtain the aqueous binder.

The embodiment also discloses a lithium ion battery, which comprises a diaphragm, wherein the diaphragm comprises a ceramic coating, the ceramic coating comprises a binder, and the binder is the aqueous binder.

The aqueous binder prepared in examples 1 to 5 was mixed with a commercially available polyacrylate emulsion type binder A and a polyacrylic acid solution type binder B, respectively with ceramic powder A and dispersant A in deionized water, and passed through a 200-mesh screen to obtain 30wt% aqueous slurry. The aqueous slurry was uniformly coated on the surface of a polyethylene-based film with a porosity of 40% of 9 μm using a coater, the thickness of the coating was 3 μm, and a ceramic primary coated membrane was obtained after drying at 80℃and tested for air permeability value, peel strength, and the related data were compared, and the specific data are shown in Table 1. The ceramic coated membrane was completely immersed in deionized water for 5min, dried at 80 c, and tested for air permeability and peel strength, and the related data were compared, and the specific data are shown in table 2. Further, a commercial emulsion type binder C, a dispersing agent B and PVDF are selected and mixed to form 10% sizing agent for coating an adhesive layer, the sizing agent is respectively coated on the primary coated ceramic membrane coated by the commercial binder A, B and the commercial emulsion type binder C, the coating thickness is 1 mu m, and the composite membrane with a double-layer coating is obtained after drying at 80 ℃, and the ventilation value and the peeling strength of the composite membrane are tested. While comparing the relevant data, the specific data are shown in table 3.

Table 1: ceramic one-layer coated diaphragm performance comparison table

Table 3: ceramic and adhesive layer two-layer coating diaphragm performance comparison table

Note that: the ventilation value and the peeling strength are tested by adopting the standard of GB/T36363-2018 polyolefin diaphragm for lithium ion battery;

as can be seen from table 1, the aqueous slurries prepared using the aqueous binders of the present invention can improve the peel strength of ceramic coatings.

As can be seen from Table 2, the aqueous slurry prepared by the aqueous binder of the invention can improve the water resistance of the ceramic coating and lay a good foundation for secondary coating.

As can be seen from Table 3, the aqueous slurry prepared by the aqueous binder of the invention can improve the peel strength of the second coating and reduce the powder falling and falling off of the second coating caused by the failure of the first binder.

The foregoing is merely a preferred embodiment of the present invention, and it should be noted that modifications and variations could be made by those skilled in the art without departing from the technical principles of the present invention, and such modifications and variations should also be regarded as being within the scope of the invention.
